  • Method Details

    • open

      public static PostgresOperatorStore open(String url, String user, String password) throws RepositoryException
      Opens the store, creating its table and case-insensitive unique index if missing. Existing accounts are retained. Each operation opens its own connection.
      Parameters:
      url - the JDBC url of the PostgreSQL database
      user - the database user
      password - the user's password, which may be empty for a local database
      Returns:
      a store whose table and index are ready
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the url or user is missing
      RepositoryException - if the database cannot be reached or prepared
